vectors.name: valid-paper-session
vectors.why: A paper session with one entry of every kind; every verifier accepts it.

vectors.name: valid-genesis-only
vectors.why: A journal can be just its first line.

vectors.name: invalid-empty-file
vectors.why: A journal has at least its first line.

vectors.name: invalid-no-final-newline
vectors.why: Every line ends in a newline, so a truncated write is visible.

vectors.name: invalid-crlf
vectors.why: Line ends are LF only.

vectors.name: invalid-blank-line
vectors.why: A blank line is not an entry.

vectors.name: invalid-not-utf8
vectors.why: The file is UTF-8.

vectors.name: invalid-extra-line-member
vectors.why: A line holds exactly entry and sig.

vectors.name: invalid-entry-missing-member
vectors.why: An entry has exactly its six members.

vectors.name: invalid-unsorted-members
vectors.why: Members are sorted, so the signed bytes are fixed.

vectors.name: invalid-integral-float
vectors.why: An integral number is written as digits: 10, not 10.0.

vectors.name: invalid-whitespace
vectors.why: No whitespace outside strings.

vectors.name: invalid-raw-non-ascii
vectors.why: Characters above U+007F are escaped.

vectors.name: invalid-number-too-large
vectors.why: Numbers stay below 1e15, where every language writes them the same way.

vectors.name: invalid-version
vectors.why: v is 1.

vectors.name: invalid-seq-skipped
vectors.why: seq counts lines from 0.

vectors.name: invalid-prev-wrong
vectors.why: prev is the hash of the line before.

vectors.name: invalid-dropped-line
vectors.why: A dropped line leaves a gap in seq.

vectors.name: invalid-reordered-lines
vectors.why: Reordered lines break seq.

vectors.name: invalid-inserted-line
vectors.why: An inserted line shifts every seq after it.

vectors.name: invalid-ts-backwards
vectors.why: ts never goes backwards.

vectors.name: invalid-ts-form
vectors.why: ts has milliseconds: exactly 24 characters.

vectors.name: invalid-ts-impossible-date
vectors.why: ts is a real calendar time: there is no 31 September.

vectors.name: invalid-ts-hour-24
vectors.why: Hours run 00 to 23.

vectors.name: invalid-ts-extended-year
vectors.why: ts is exactly 24 characters, which also keeps text order equal to time order.

vectors.name: invalid-ts-year-zero
vectors.why: Years start at 0001.

vectors.name: invalid-first-line-prev
vectors.why: Line 0 has no previous line: its prev is null.

vectors.name: invalid-unknown-kind
vectors.why: Only the ten kinds.

vectors.name: invalid-first-line-not-config
vectors.why: Line 0 is the config that names the key.

vectors.name: invalid-order-without-qty
vectors.why: An order states its quantity.

vectors.name: invalid-mark-zero-price
vectors.why: A mark is a price above 0.

vectors.name: invalid-correction-of-a-later-line
vectors.why: A correction corrects an earlier line.

vectors.name: invalid-genesis-bad-key
vectors.why: Line 0 names a 32-byte Ed25519 key.

vectors.name: invalid-signed-by-another-key
vectors.why: Every line is signed by the key from line 0.

vectors.name: invalid-edited-after-signing
vectors.why: Changing a signed entry breaks its signature.

vectors.name: invalid-signature-not-64-bytes
vectors.why: SIG is 64 bytes of base64.
